DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder).

The normal MRI results and lack of inflammatory markers rule out rotator cuff tears and active arthritis, while the severe restriction in both active and passive range of motion (especially internal rotation) is classic for adhesive capsulitis. Since I have reached the limit of my questions, no further testing is required.
